{"confidence":1,"answer":"For Best Buy in FY2015, FY2016, and FY2017, the net profit margins (net earnings attributable to Best Buy Co., Inc. shareholders divided by revenue) are as follows:
- FY2015: Net earnings of $1,233 million / Revenue of $40,339 million = 3.06% (or 3.1% using net earnings including noncontrolling interests of $1,235 million = 3.06%)
- FY2016: Net earnings of $897 million / Revenue of $39,528 million = 2.27%
- FY2017: Net earnings of $1,228 million / Revenue of $39,403 million = 3.12%

Using net earnings attributable to Best Buy Co., Inc. shareholders, the 3-year average net profit margin is 2.8% (specifically, approximately 2.82%).
